summary.description: Tactical SMA with +3%/-1.5% asymmetric buffer bands, RSI/MACD/VIX confirmation, and SGOV cash yield.
Graduated allocation based on RSI. Contrarian: adds leverage when oversold.
Baseline: all $5k/week into USD. Constant 2x leverage.
Contrarian: reduce leverage when overextended, add when oversold.
Inversely scale leverage with VIX. Full de-leverage during market crises.
Static equal allocation across all three leverage levels.
Saves cash during overextensions, then deploys 100% of cash into SOXL/USD when deep downturns occur.
Blended SMA + RSI + VIX score for robust regime detection.
PlayBit 200 EMA channel (±1% buffers) 3x / 2x / CASH, capped at 1x when the index is >15% off its 52-week high, below its 100 EMA, or 20d realised vol > 40%.
Binary regime switching using 50/200 SMA. Full leverage in uptrends, none in downtrends.
Four-quadrant MACD: leverage scales with trend direction and strength.
Baseline: all $5k/week into SOXL. Constant 3x leverage.
Self-protective: automatically de-leverages as portfolio drops from peak.
stateless SOXX > 200 SMA switch between 2x leveraged SOXX and high-yield CASH.
stateless SOXX > 200 SMA switch between a blended Tech/AI basket (2.0x leverage) and high-yield CASH.
4-tier stepped de-risking with 1% buffer: SOXL (>50 & >200), USD (<50 & >200), SOXX (>50 & <200), and SPAXX (<50 & <200).
Baseline: all $5k/week into SOXX. No leverage.
4-tier stepped de-risking: SOXL (>50 & >200), USD (<50 & >200), SOXX (>50 & <200), and SPAXX (<50 & <200).
PlayBit 200 EMA channel: 3x above the High-EMA, 2x inside the channel, high-yield CASH below the Close-EMA.
stateless SOXX > 200 SMA switch between 3x leveraged SOXX and high-yield CASH.
PlayBit 200 EMA channel: 3x above the High-EMA, unleveraged 1x inside the channel, high-yield CASH below the Close-EMA.
stateless SOXX > 200 SMA switch between 1x SOXX and high-yield CASH.
